items.text: 📰 Send Monica the Paul Wells article (reminded 13:33; tick it when done).

🔴 Mon 28, 10:30: your PMP mid-year with Olivier. His item 4 is your feedback on his leadership. Then 11:00 the Avocats sans frontières Canada logic model, Maxime organising.
⚠️ Wed 7 Oct, 10:00: Sally's bilat clashes with DEV-Trade coordination.
⏰ Thu 8 Oct: deadline for reviewing the Guatemala concept notes. Also 11:30 NDB/Mission IA management.
🏛 G13 matrix, Ministerio Público column. All eighteen Canadian rows blank. The Fiscal General is four months into the job.
🦻 DINTELEC. A medical statement that the aids were for you: patient, practitioner, medical need. Not another invoice copy. Say the word and I will draft it.
🔧 THREE MROs left: office electricity · office bathroom · the broken bed. (The dishwasher was scheduled for this morning.)
🔌 UPS bought. When it arrives: lamp test the sockets, put all three devices on the battery-backed side.
🖼 Francisco Choc, hangs photos and artwork: 3153 0761
🛋 Bedside lamp · 🔌 two cables · 🧾 store credit (print the email first)
